title: Direct implementation activates Development OS with Lean
prompt: Fix the release script bug, run the checks, and get the repository to a clean preview candidate.

title: Proof work activates Development OS with Evidence Stewardship
prompt: Audit whether this deployment is actually ready and tell me what evidence is still missing.

title: Architecture exploration activates Development OS with perspective
prompt: Rethink this architecture and challenge whether our current representation is the best one before we commit.

title: Unresolved product meaning activates Development OS with Founder-to-Feature
prompt: We need to decide whether published revisions should mean latest revision or the last integrated revision. Help me resolve it.

title: External wait routes through the Development OS kernel
context: A development session is already active and the primary deployment is externally blocked.
prompt: The provider is still building. Use the wait productively and continue when it becomes actionable.

title: Terse development re-entry restores Development OS
context: The prior turn was an authorized software-development session that was interrupted during provider work.

title: Ordinary non-development writing does not activate Development OS
prompt: Write a short birthday poem about autumn.
